payload.purpose_context: Slice 2 of the large-hubs epic (#340), issue #342. Slice 1 (#341) caps a large hub's sidebar group to its overview link plus one 'N pages' entry that leads to the hub. This mission makes the hub page itself bounded: it renders the first page of children and links static /<hub>/page/N/ pages in the Starlight frame through an accessible pagination nav. Paged URLs are self-canonical and kept out of the sitemap, and the link gate and agent surfaces stay green.
payload.purpose_tldr: A hub over its sidebar child cap lists its children across static, server-rendered pages, so every child is reachable without scripts.

options: Fold in: every hub gets an entry with a capped flag; hub page and paged routes read that one resolved data; Closes #429 too
Do not fold: paged routes compose children from the collection themselves; #429 stays open
Partial: emit data for over-cap hubs on custom-sidebar sites too, not every hub
payload.question: Fold #429 (widen HubCap route-shaping data to every kind: Hub hub, also on sites with their own sidebar) into this mission?

payload.final_answer: Fold in: every kind: Hub hub gets an entry in every sidebar mode, HubCap shape kept with a capped flag; hub page and paged routes read that one resolved data; PR closes #342 and #429

options: Page size = the hub resolved sidebar child cap; only hubs over their cap are paged
Separate page-size setting (hub/section/site), default 50; only hubs over their cap are paged
Separate page-size setting; every hub over its page size is paged, regardless of the cap
payload.question: How many children per listing page, and which hubs are paged?

payload.final_answer: B: separate page-size setting at hub/section/site, default 50, resolved most specific first like the cap; only hubs over their sidebar child cap are paged.
